parameters.description:
`msg-to-freemobile` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Free-Mobile destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Free-Mobile destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Free-Mobile destinations bound per enrollment.

Log in to your account at mobile.free.fr, then go to Mon Compte → Options and turn on 'Notifications par SMS' — Free Mobile will show your account identifier and generate a dedicated API key for this feature. Set the identifier as FREEMOBILE_USER and the generated API key as FREEMOBILE_PASSWORD; UnitySVC then sends each message as a free SMS to your own Free Mobile line.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Free-Mobile destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Free-Mobile SMS API
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Free-Mobile destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.
